Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The problem specifically exists within ASCORE.dll, a DLL used by the Message Engine RPC server. This service exposes a heap overflow vulnerability through RPC opcode 43 (0x2b) and a stack overflow vulnerability through RPC opcode 45 (0x2d) on TCP port 6503 endpoint with ID dc246bf0-7a7a-11ce-9f88-00805fe43838. The flaws are exposed when passing long strings as the second parameter to either opcode. Computer Associates has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
